kenneyStyleGuidance.primaryRule: Judge visible art direction before object name or category. A simplified computer is not automatically appropriate for a premium technology website.
kenneyStyleGuidance.fallbackRule: No Kenney asset is hard-blocked. If no closer catalog match exists, use the best available fallback deliberately, generally at a smaller scale or as a supporting object.
kenneyStyleGuidance.architectureRule: More detailed architectural records can carry larger stylized roles, but remain low-poly and should not be mistaken for photoreal visualization.
